actual_checks: Full exact prompt, metadata/API/provenance, report and full prior announcement read. The literature result proves the complete n=2 instance, with a precise transfer obstruction to extrapolation; it does not claim all finite n or strict infinity.

Geometric nerve in source 1.8 uses strict 2-functors from the stated 2-simplex with endpoint-containing subsets ordered by reverse inclusion. Its convention matches the report. Theorem 3.6 gives proper combinatorial model structure; 3.7 supplies the displayed c2 Sd^2 / Ex^2 N2 Quillen equivalence with correct attributions.

Weak equivalences detected by N2 and Ex^2 N2 agree via objectwise weak id->Ex and two-out-of-three. Cofibrations are the weakly saturated c2 Sd^2-boundary generators, including k=0, not all object injections. Corollary 3.9 explicitly gives weak-equivalence unit and counit on all objects, not merely derived equivalence.

Lemma 4.2 has both small-object hypotheses and G(lr(F(J))) contained in W. Adjunction, local presentability and nerve detection alone leave that latter condition unproved. Properness is separately imported. This identifies an actual mathematical gap in naïve universal transfer, without asserting a negative theorem in other dimensions.
